subject_rendering:
I know that my distress will become my deliverance through your prayers and the generous help of the Spirit of Jesus Christ. I eagerly expect and hope that I will have no reason to be ashamed. Instead, I will face this with complete courage so that Christ will be honored through me, whether I live or die.

For me, living is Christ, and dying is gain. If I go on living, I can continue doing fruitful work. I do not know which I would prefer. I am pulled in both directions. I long to leave this life and be with Christ, which is far better. But remaining alive is more necessary for your sake.

Since I am convinced of this, I know that I will remain and continue with all of you for your progress and joy as you trust Christ. Then, when I am with you again, you will have even more reason to rejoice in Christ Jesus because of me.

strengths: Strong balance of clarity and warrant
warnings: Dynamic clarification of τοῦτο; defensible, but interpretive and should remain documented.
